---
description: Generate 20 hooks for a topic, score them, keep the best 10
---

Generate 20 hooks for the topic given as input, then keep the best 10.

Rules:
- Read brief/campaign-brief.md first if it exists, and outputs/research/voice-of-customer.md if it exists. Tune hooks to that audience, their pains and their real phrases. Otherwise write for a general professional audience.
- Draft 20 across these types: contrarian, number, story, question, pain (4 each).
- Each hook is 1-2 sentences, 200 characters or fewer, and works as the first line of a post. No clickbait the topic cannot pay off. No hashtags, no emojis.
- Score each of the 20 from 1 to 5 on specificity, tension, and fit with the brief. Keep the top 10 by total, with at least 3 hook types represented.
- Count characters with code when you can run commands.

Output the 10 winners as a table: rank, hook, type, score, best platform (LinkedIn, X or Instagram), characters. Then one line on why the top 2 stop the scroll. Do not list the 10 dropped hooks.
